articleTitle: A Hybrid Encryption Algorithm Based on DES and RSA in Bluetooth Communication
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: To enhance the security of data transmission in Bluetooth communication, a hybrid encryption algorithm based on DES and RSA is proposed. The currently used encryption algorithm employed by the Bluetooth to protect the confidentiality of data during transport between two or more devices is a 128-bit symmetric stream cipher called E0. It may be broken under certain conditions with the time complexity O(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">64</sup>). In the proposed hybrid encryption algorithm, instead of the E0 encryption, DES algorithm is used for data transmission because of its higher efficiency in block encryption, and RSA algorithm is used for the encryption of the key of the DES because of its management advantages in key cipher. Under the dual protection with the DES algorithm and the RSA algorithm, the data transmission in the Bluetooth system will be more secure. Meanwhile, it is clear that the procedure of the entire encryption is still simple and efficient as ever. In addition, the confidentiality of the hybrid encryption algorithm is also discussed.

articleTitle: Applications of Three-Dimensional Geological Modeling in the Development of Da Qingzi Oilfield
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Three-dimensional geological modeling which is based on geologic and seismic results, displays three-dimensional visualization of the underground construction, reservoirs and sand body distribution, reveals the distribution of oil and gas and establishes geological model parameters to describe the distribution of oil and gas and characters of flow. It has deepened the understanding of the study blocks and improved the success of wells drilling, saving a lot of money. In recent years, with the rapid development of computer technology, oil and gas reservoir modeling method has made great development.

articleTitle: Urban Traffic Noise Analysis and Control Measures
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The sources of urban traffic noise, as well as causes of various noises were introduced. Control measures of urban traffic noise were proposed. According to the mechanism of the noise, control the noises of road traffic and rail traffic from the following respective aspects, running vehicles, road pavement, surrounding environment, national laws and regulations etc. It is possible to provide references for relevant departments to formulate laws and regulations related to vehicle noise and city municipal building.

articleTitle: An Extended Marker-Based Tracking System for Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Fiducial marker systems consist of unique patterns mounted in the environment and computer vision algorithms that help automatically find features in digital camera images. They are useful for Augmented Reality (AR), robot navigation, 3D modeling, and other applications. In this paper we introduce an extension of marker-based approaches. For some applications which need a large working space, we mounted markers onto the ceiling. Two cameras are fixed onto the head-mounted displays (one captures the markers and the other captures the real scene). After calibration of the two cameras, the pose of the camera captures the real scene can be obtained to merge virtual scene.

articleTitle: The Listed Company's Credit Rating Based on Logistic Regression Model Add Non-financial Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper designs a set of enterprise credit rating index system,in addition to traditional financial ratios, it joined the non-financial factors. then used the logical regression approach to create company's credit rating model, the result shows that the overall discrimination rate reached 95%, the models predict results accurately.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Frequency Hopping Anti-jamming Communication System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: With the better capabilities of anti-jamming, low-probability of interception and networking, frequency hopping communication is one of the most widely used technologies at present. In order to study and validate the anti-jamming capability of FH communication system, it is urgently needed to establish a high efficiency simulation platform. Based on the characteristics of FH communication system, this paper designs a kind of more high-efficient and practical simulation platform. The bit error rate (BER) performance is simulated under the two conditions of Gaussian noise and Gaussian noise plus partial-band jamming.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Grid Control Service Information and Communication Network Reliability Model
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper aims at exploring the reliability model based on communication network that carries power grid control service information, it analyzes service type and feature of the power grid control information carried by electric power communication network and the communication network transmission requirements. It studies the method of abstracting reliability parameters of the communication link for power grid control service (i.e. constructing a mapping from error rate to reliability). It analyzes factors and types of faults of node devices and optical cables that affect network reliability. It puts forward several kinds of reliability models for the typical electric power communication network. It gives some suggestions on studying the reliability of the electric power communication network on the basis of relevant studies on the reliability of the electric power communication network. Finally, it introduces the progress and achievement of relevant studies. It can provide reference for researchers on the reliability of electric power communication.

articleTitle: Analysis of Solar Auto-tracking System Kinematics and Static Force
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: An auto-tracking system of solar transmission mechanism was established by SolidWorks software. And motion simulation of the system was done by COSMOSMotion. Meanwhile, static force analysis under the weight load of the solar auto-tracking system was conducted by finite element model with ANSYS. A detailed simulation analysis of the system was performed and we gave solutions to the whole process. The results showed that kinematic analysis could achieve the desired results, and the phenomenon of interference did not occur. Also, under weight load condition, the mechanism stiffness and strength data showed that the system would fully meet the needs of the design.

articleTitle: Innovative Genetic Algorithm for Solving GTSP
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: There are two kinds of Generalized Traveling Salesman Problems (GTSP) corresponding to the different restraint conditions, which the cost functions satisfy. This study aims at solving a special case of the second kind of GTSP, where the triangular inequality constraint still remains valid for the edge costs within districts. An innovative genetic algorithm using generalized chromosomes with void vertices is employed to solve the special GTSP. Case study of simulation for benchmark test problems shows that the proposed algorithm is considerably successful.

articleTitle: Study of Collaborative Information Systems of 4PL Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The rapid development of the networking has provided the safeguard and vigor for the logistics model. A new logistics way-The fourth party logistics(4PL) comes into being. The 4PL is providing an integration platform for the management, IT and any other logistics information which takes the third-party logistics as foundation. The 4PL is not a single enterprise but an enterprises group aggregated by a lot of relative enterprises. Each enterprise of this group must collaborative with each other. This paper not only presents a function model of collaborative information systems but also studies the key technologies and solution to realize the model. The model's realization can partially solve the ”work cooperation”, “information cooperation”, ”resource cooperation”. The establishment of a collaborative information system of 4PL has a positive effect for modern logistics enterprises to improve competitiveness and economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Multiple Mode Protection Switching Failure Recovery Mechanism under MPLS Network
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: In order to solve the problem of constrained routing algorithm without capability of dealing with failures, this paper proposes a failure recovery method based on multiple mode protection switching including global protection???segment protection and local protection. This method quantifies the performance of three protections switching styles as a protection metric, making use of this metric to computer the optimal protection style for the working path. This paper put this failure recovery method into constrained routing algorithm to enhance the invulnerability of the algorithm

articleTitle: From Micro to Macro: A Study on the Adaptability Model of Learning Organizational Change
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Since 1990s, learning organization is considered as a new trend and an ideal mode of the global organizational management in the knowledge economy era. As to the research of learning organization change with attributes of complex system, the theory of complex adaptive system provides a possible way on methodology. This paper reviews theory of complex adaptive system and learning organization, analyzes the adaptability of learning organizational change, and gives the conceptual model. Additionally this paper elaborates evolution mechanism of learning organizational change, and extracts the impact factors. In order to obtain information accurately and timely, the overall and comprehensive effects can only play depending on the collaboration among the adaptive agents. The enterprises in reality should reduce the risks of adjusting organizational elements to adapt to the environment changing bigger and faster than their own. The conclusion of this study is some referentially significant for those who try to promote the level of the organization's adaptability.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Harmonious Labor Relations of Chinese Private Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: On the basis of related research, by practical survey of private enterprises this paper has designed an indicator system for harmonious labor relations in eight aspects of compensation, labor intensity and working time, social insurance and benefit, labor safety and health, training and career prospects, inner human relations, contract and democratic management, and work of labor union. Then by AHP method we construct a model to calculate harmonious labor relations. We use this model to calculate the harmonious labor relations of two private enterprises. According to the results of the empirical analysis, we propose several suggestions for the construction of harmonious labor relations of private enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of PCA in Controlling and Reducing Enterprise Logistic Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Logistic cost is accompanied by logistic activities. A logistic cost is an important indicator to measure the production efficiency of an enterprise. With strengthening the logistic management awareness, how to effectively reduce logistic cost has become a core mission. Using primary components analysis (PCA) and its advantages, influential factors on logistic cost reduction in enterprise material conveying is analyzed. On the basis of PCA model and scores by the experts, the authors computed some results that can reflect logistic cost reduction. Through case study, it can be seen that some factors play very important role and all the reasons should be taken into account because logistic cost reduction depends on the interaction of all the factors. Through analysis and deduction, it is concluded that, under the premise of minimizing the information loss of data, the application of PCA in the investigation on logistic cost reduction in enterprise material conveying approves to be practicable.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy C-Means Clustering Algorithm and Application in Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The fuzzy clustering algorithm is sensitive to the m value and the degree of membership. Because of the deficiencies of traditional FCM clustering algorithm and we also made specific improvement methods. Through the calculation of the value of m, the amendments of degree of membership to the discussion of issues, effectively compensate for the deficiencies of the traditional algorithm and achieve a relatively good clustering effect. Finally, through the analysis of temperature observation data of the three northeastern province of china in 2000, verify the reasonableness of the method.

articleTitle: 3D Fine Geological Modeling of the High Water Cut Stage Reservoir: A Case Study of the ES2S1 Reservoir in the Southern Pucheng Oilfield
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: 3D computer modeling is the most important procedure in the reservoir fine description, It can help us to study the reservoir with quantitative and three-dimensional methods. This paper presents an example of the application 3D modeling to the first sand set of the upper ES2 reservoir in the south region of Pucheng Oilfield. Based on the basic data of the strata and structure, faults and structure model are built to display the 3D structure characteristics of the reservoir. The sedimentary microfacies data is imported and analyzed in the software and the variogram is defined to build the microfacies model. And then facies controlled petrophysical modeling technology is used when building the petrophysical model. Finally, In order to examine the precision of the built 3D geological model, according to the fluid model, the geological reserves of each zone is calculated, result manifests that the trueness error is reasonable, and the exported 3D model can be used in the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Investigation of Propeller-Wing Interaction Based on the Sliding Mesh Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The aerodynamic characteristics of propeller-wing interaction for the Rocket Launched UAV were simulated numerically based on the High Performance Computing Cluster System by means of sliding mesh technology. The results showed that the effects on the wing made by the rotating propeller were much notable. The forces and moments data were collected for axial wing placements ranging from 0.056 to 0.5D and varied rotating speeds. A representative portion of a data set for the speed setting of 6000rpm and fixed =0 was included show the various forces and moments. The drag can be seen to remain relatively constant as the aircraft moved progressively closer to the propeller until the wing was positioned at 0.056D downstream of the propeller, where a nearly 20% increase occurred. Based on the pressure cloud and streamlines, the vortices generated by propeller, propeller-wing interaction, and wing-tip were captured and analyzed.

articleTitle: BESO of Structures with Constrained Damping
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Optimization of structures with constrained layer damping by bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization???BESO???was studied in this paper. The sensitivity equation of the objective function about deleted and added elements was built for maximization of modal loss factor of constrained layer damping structure. Firstly the FEA model of the metal structure without constrained layer damping are built, and the mode shapes are calculated. Secondly substitute the mode shapes into the sensitivity formula, to calculate the sensitivity of the elements of the metal structure with supposed constrained damping. Thirdly sort to find the element with negative or minimum modulus sensitivity, and stick the material to where those elements are to initialize the optimization configuration. BESO then was import into the optimization base on the initial optimization configuration. If a pair of deleted and added elements increase the certain stage modal damping ratio, the pair then should be implemented until no such pairs, then the optimal layout of the constrained layer damping materials we get. The mass added should be equal to the deleted to assure the mass of the constrained layer damping material. The example shows that BESO can get the optimal layout of the given mass of damping materials to maximize the certain stage loss factor and save 90% time compared to ESO. The reasonable result demonstrates the effectiveness and engineering value of the method.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Simulating Urban Heat Island Phenomenon During Unusual High Temperature and Drought Period in 2006 Summer in Chongqing, China
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Chongqing city locates at the foothill, where the Jialing River and the Yangtze River joins. A severely high temperature and drought occurred in the summer of 2006. So, it has been very necessary and urgent to know the affection trend and extent of the urban heat island to high temperature in urban during that period. The temperature data measured at automatic weather stations was used to statistic the urban heat island. High resolute numeric model was used to simulate the urban heat island distribution and its influences to high temperature. The researches showed that there was a clear urban heat island phenomenon in Chongqing. The average of the daily urban heat island intensity in the summer was 1.0°C and the maximal reached 1.8°C. The urban heat island intensity varied clearly in a day. It was stronger in nighttime than it was in daytime. The average of night urban heat island intensity in summer was 1.4°C and the maximal reached 2.6°C. The appearance of urban heat island probably increased the high temperature harm at night. The refined temperature distribution and numerical simulating results clearly showed the temperature and the urban heat island distribution. The results indicated that the temperature and the urban heat island were affected by the city zone, hills and rivers, etc, at the same time. The highest heat island was located in Shapingba district, east of Zhongliang hill, which was mainly because of dense buildings, industries and isolated wind velocity field in it. Along the river area of Jiangbei, Yuzhong, Nanan, Jiulongpo, Dadukou formed connected high heat island areas, which were all old districts with high urbanization. The high temperature harm in night in urban increased by the urban heat island.

articleTitle: Crack Propagation Simulation and Residual Life Analysis of Coupler Yoke
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The operation of 20,000-ton heavy haul freight cars on Datong-Qinhuangdao Railway has played a very important role on the economic development of China, and at the same time it caused serious damage to the couplers and coupler yokes of the freight cars, threatening the traffic safety. In this paper, taking cracks on the coupler yoke into account, the stress intensity factors (SIF) for different crack sizes are calculated using the approach of 1/4 node displacement and sub-model techniques. The commercial finite element code ABAQUS is used for modeling and 3-D prismatic quarter point 20-node isoparametric degenerate singular elements are adopted for the region near the crack tip. Models on fatigue crack growth and residual life prediction are applied with help of Paris equation. Finally, AAR load spectrum is provided and the relationship between crack propagation size and wagon operation mileage is obtained. The work provides fundamental data for setting up the inspection plan and assessing the replacement period of the coupler yoke.

articleTitle: A Construction Approach of Small World Network in Large Distributed System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: How to effectively locate resources is a very important factor affecting the performance of large distributed environment. Some resource discovery methods have been already proposed, which utilizes Small World phenomena. In this paper, on the base of Kleinberg Small World model, this paper proposes an efficient decentralized construction approach SSWCP (Scalable Small World Construction Protocol), which uses partial view instead of global knowledge of network. Through analysis and simulations, we show that SSWCP is efficient for resource discovery, scalable to very large network sizes.

articleTitle: A Novel Infrared Sensor Structure Compatible to Standard CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper presents a new type of un-cooled thermal infrared sensor, which is compatible to standard CMOS process. The proposed infrared sensor adopts a suspended n-well containing several p+/n-well diodes as infrared sensing element. The thermal analysis indicates that the sensor exhibits excellent steady-state and transient thermal property. The theoretical analysis shows that the temperature coefficient is independent of temperature and process parameters, which is not true for conventional infrared sensors using single p-n diode. The simulation results based on SMIC 0.18μm CMOS process are consistent with theoretical ones. Compared to traditional p-n diode infrared sensor, the proposed structure is more suitable for constructing an infrared focal plane array (IRFPA) for imaging applications.

articleTitle: Operational Experiment Based on Artificial Life Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Mathematical analysis method based on equation will encounter in a little difficulties hard to overcome when conducting combat experiments, while the artificial life modeling and simulation approach is a new system modeling and simulation method. In this paper, the latest developments of the field of artificial life have been explored. the basic theory of artificial life, modeling methods and modeling tools have been specially studied on. Based on the thought of artificial life, combined with genetic algorithm, the operational experiments in two-dimensional grid environment and three-dimensional MGIS environment have been studied. The results can provide a reference for the expansion of artificial life and evolutionary computation for operational experiments field.

articleTitle: Investigation on Identification of Distributed Dynamic Load in Complicated Structures Based on Spacial Mapping and Orthogonal Polynomials
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: In this paper, based on the theory of two-dimensional (2-D) orthogonal polynomials, the function of dynamic load is fit by using the primary functions. The fitting coefficients are identified through finite element analysis. The identification method of distributed dynamic load is found. Space mapping is used to reduces the dimension of the model, while the box-structure which bears the distributed load, from 3-D to 2-D. Then the load can be identified by the theory of 2-D orthogonal polynomials, and finally those identified load can be re-mapped to the real case in 3-D. The simulation results show that the method is simple, effective and precise as long as enough data of feedback points are collected.

articleTitle: Geological Modeling of the Terminal Fan Reservoir in Hai120 Block of Jilin Oilfield
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Terminal fan system is distinguished in Hai120 block, which consists of three different microfacies proximal subfacies, middle subfacies and distal subfacies are identified by combining the core observation, log interpretation and electron microscopy viewing, each subfacies includes a number of microfacies. Reservoir characterization plays an essential role in quantitative reservoir description, it can improve capacity of understanding reservoir, thus in this paper we mainly detailedly characterise microfacies, which have prominent impacts on the reservoir properties, herein presents the connection between reservoir properties and the facies, plus applying stochastic modeling method to build reservoir properties model. This study has a direct role in guiding the oil field development.

articleTitle: Solution on Tie in Three-Opinion Dynamics Research
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Group discussion is an newly important way in discrete dynamic models, we named it Galam models. In each update procession, the population will be divided into groups with a fixed number of members. After discussion, each group will share the same opinion. However, in such away we will encounter a common problem, which is that a tie appears in a group. We can solve the problem in many ways, but one thing we have to consider about is fairness. In this paper, we discuss on two kinds solution. One way is to randomly select one of the opinions in a tie, the other is to select the nearest group's common opinion. We use simulation tools to simulate these two ways and make comparison based on the simulation results. At last we also study the importance of a opinion's initial supported rate in order to win the dynamics.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Selection of Optimal Wavelet Basis for Radio Fuze Jamming Identification

articleTitle: Image Analysis Based Measurement and Calculation of Fractal Characteristic of Pore Structure of Peanut Cake
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The microstructures of peanut cake under five levels of applied pressures are measured using stereo light microscope and Image-pro software. Employing the box-counting method, the fractal dimensions of pore structure of peanut cake are measured and calculated. Result shows that the fractal characteristic of peanut cake is obvious. It is found that applied pressure has a significant effect on the fractal dimension, and its value decreases significantly with the increase of applied pressure. It is concluded that with increasing applied pressure the pore structure is further complicated.

articleTitle: Study on an Improved Naive Bayesian Classifier Used in the Chinese Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Text Categorization is an important research branch in the data mining domain. In this paper, an improved Naive Bayesian Classifier which is based on the Genetic Algorithms is proposed. It can make an effective Naive Bayesian classifier with excellent attributes Set in the field of text categorization. The experiments show that this method has a good classification performance.

articleTitle: Using Computer Simulation in Operating Room Management: Impacts of Information Quality on Process Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: High quality information has a significant impact on improving operation performance and patient satisfaction, as well as resolving patient disputes. Based on the analysis of the perioperative process, information quality is considered as an important contributory factor in improving patient throughput. In this paper, we propose a conceptual framework to use computer simulations in modeling information flow of hospital process for operating room management (ORM). Additionally, we conduct simulation studies in different levels of the information quality for ORM. The results of our studies provide evidence that information quality can drive process performance in several phases of the ORM.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Effect of Thermal Expansion Coefficient on Combined Stress of Hot Forging Die
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Stresses, including thermal, mechanical and combined stress, are the root causes leading to hot forging die failure. Stress amplitude is affected by the material properties, such as thermal expansion coefficient. In order to select die material for improving die service life, a 2D FE model is developed to analyze thermal, mechanical and combined stress of hot forging die with different level thermal expansion coefficient. Three kinds of stress distribution are explored. The results show that thermal stress is about 10 times than mechanical stress at the die cavity surface which is the easiest failure location, and approximate linear relationship exists between stress, including thermal and combined stress, and thermal expansion coefficient. Die material with small room temperature and temperature-sensitive thermal expansion coefficient should be selected.

articleTitle: General Analysis of Requirements for Risk-Oriented Financial Data Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Data modeling is a challenge field in computer engineering. Although researcher made great progresses theoretically, mature technologies in developing and designing are still on the way of exploring. We are engaged in a kind of novel financial data modeling. In the course of our study we found a new method usable in our developing, namely, general analysis of requirements. With this new thought, our work makes breakthrough in process. This paper intends to introduce our study work and the conclusion. We firstly present the new method with which our research is smoothed. We also discuss this method as an exploration in theory. Secondly, we elicit the general requirements for the financial data model from various needs of stakeholders or other roles interested as a common request in the same kind of software usage. Thirdly, we disambiguate the misunderstanding in conception of risk information. Finally we put out the concept of risk used in financial data model as a result of general analysis of requirements. In this paper we also propose the thought of Software Requirements Generalization (SRG) for the first time. This method can be extended to all the computer software designing and developing.

articleTitle: Comparing the Effects of Different Water Model on Computed Structural Character of H1 Peptide
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The structural and dynamics character of H1 peptide in aqueous solution has been investigated through temperature replica exchange molecular dynamics simulations with using two different water combined with OPLS-AA force field.

articleTitle: Structural Character of Protein Complex a-syn12 Peptide and Synphilin-1 Studied Using Molecular Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations method was used to study the dynamics and structural character of α-syn12 peptide complex with synphilin-1 protein in aqueous solution at low pH by using GROMOS 43A1 force field. The α-syn12 peptide aggregates faster at low pH than at neutral pH.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Combinatorial Predict Model of Enterprise Profit Based on Stochastic Partial Elasticity Theory and Artificial Neural Network

articleTitle: The Study on the Programmable Automation Based on Data Medium Moby-I
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: A programmable automation based on data medium Moby-I is designed in this paper. The whole scheme of the system is brought forward firstly. And then, the data structures of the data medium Moby-I is programmed, the sequence of the multistation assembly control are expatiated, which are focused on the data exchange of general mechanism between PLC system and the Moby. The design of the system is universal, reliable and flexible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: 3D Geological Structures Modeling in Qingshankou Formation in Hei 71-56 Area of the Daqingzijing Oil Field

articleTitle: The Workflow Management System of the Acquisition Based on Capacity and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem of the change in world acquisition model, a new acquisition strategy which was called the acquisition based on capacity and simulation was proposed. It will enhance the efficiency of our defense acquisition. Particularly, this paper has newly contrived a workflow management system according to the strategy. The proposed strategy was achieved by information technology. Large and complex acquisition management work processes can be changed easily in the workflow management system. And the processes can be added, deleted and joined expediently. It solved the diversity and the uncertainty methods of the large and complex acquisition. The framework can propose a series of feasible solutions and give us higher-level of efficiency in improving the quality of workflow models.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Workload Driven Approach for the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Recently, cloud computing has shown promising foreground in distributed application. There are many computer resources on the cloud, but how to schedule these resources reasonable is a very important and difficult issue. In this paper, we provide a real-time workload driven approach for the cloud, and the workload between slave and master on the cloud will keep balance subtlety. There are four important parts to get the goal of real-time workload driven functions for cloud, and we described and discussed the implementation of the structure. It is applicable in the larger-scale and real-time required functions particularly.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Long-Scale Bag Filter
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The finite element model of steel structure of bag filter is established and the stress distribution and deformation of steel structure under different load cases are analyzed with finite element analysis software ANSYS. The results show that the model of bag filter which is established with ANSYS and the calculate method are rational, and the analysis result is reliable, they are supply theoretical base for the further optimal design of bag filter.

articleTitle: Building and Rendering of Geometry Line Model under VRML Complex Space Object Collection
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Geometry line modeling technique is basically a kind of important modeling application when proceeding space complex object construction. First, paper introduced rules for building VRML virtual line model, including IndexedLineSet node's function and its syntax format etc. Here we mainly discussed some of IndexedLineSet node's important fields' meaning, for example coord and coordIndex field, color and colorIndex field, also colorPerVertex field. Second, paper designed application examples for illustrating rendering and building method for VRML's geometry space complex line Model. Finally, paper pointed out that for any complex natural modeling object, we all can use VRML provided PointSet, IndexedLineSet, IndexedFaceSet, ElevationGrid and Extrusion node, as Shape modeling node's geometry field value, for constructing.

articleTitle: Novel Neural Network and Its Application in Hysteresis Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: A novel neural network with chaotic property is proposed. The network is composed by different neurons. Some activation function is chaotic iterative function instead of the conventional Sigmoid function. In the process of learning, taking advantage of the randomicity property and ergodicity property of chaos, the generalization capability and the optimizing efficiency can be improved. The simulation results prove the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The Procedure Modeling Algorithm for Traditional Korean Window: 3D Modeling Traditional Korean Window Muntin Bars
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The traditional Korean window frames, which were made of wood and Korean paper, called hanji, have been designed by dividing 2D surface with multiple lines. Those lines represent symmetrical geometric characteristics. This research describes the method of procedure modeling the traditional Korean windows.

articleTitle: Does Technology Transfer Facilitate Technological Progress? Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of technology transfer which consists of imports of technology and purchase of domestic technology on total factor productivity for a cross sectional sample of large and medium-sized industrial enterprises by 30 major provinces or regions in China. The possible determinants of total factor productivity are sought with special focus on technology transfer. An endogeneity test is performed in order to examine whether inconsistent results exist or not. Empirical results indicate that technology transfer, the level of R&D and human capital are the most significant factors enhancing total factor productivity in Chinese industries. The findings in this paper support the argument that accelerating technology transfer is an effective way of facilitating technology progress in China.

articleTitle: Facies Modeling of Complex Reservoir in Fluvial Delta System: A Case Study of Wei2 Block of Chian Oilfield
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Wei2 block of Chian Oilfield is deposited by Fluvial delta which have three major depositional microfacies: distributary channel, mouth bar and sheet sand. Through more than 10 years' development, the underground reservoir is complex and takes on some acute contradictions. Thus it is an emphasis to build a fine reservoir model for the modern reservoir management. The fundamental work which it needs to do is to study the microfacies, it can show us a precise distribution and tendency of the sand. The paper mainly detailedly characterise the microfacies, that can clarify the reservoir properties. As limited knowledge about reservoir geometries is available, variogram based on stochastic modeling is an appropriate method to obtain a real geological body.

articleTitle: Multi-Parameters Study on Landfill Pole-Dipole Leak Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The theoretical model of pole- dipole landfill leak detection and the parameters that influence the location results are studied in this paper. Parametric curves for a single leak show that the greater the thickness of the media above the liner, and the greater the distance from dipole and HDPE, the lower of the detection sensitivity; in a certain range, expand the dipole spacing, leaks can be detected effectively. To identify and resolve multiple leaks, the potential measurements must be made close to the liner and the detector dipole spacing must smaller than the separation of the leak.

articleTitle: Advance Research of Geometry Face Model under VRML Complex Object Muster
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Special face modeling functions included in VRML's IndexedFaceSet node have been discussed in this paper. Mainly, paper introduced some unusual fields for building special face model, including texCoord and texCoordIndex field, normal and normalIndex field, also normalPerVertex field, as well as convex and creaseAngle field. Secondly, paper researched application methods for extraordinary face object modeling and rendering. Finally, other particular techniques for constructing VRML's complex object muster, like ElevationGrid and Extrusion node, are stated briefly.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Complex Adaptability of Chinese Telecom Enterprise in Organization Change
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: In recent years, the irresistible trend of economic globalization, networking and intellectualization has brought unprecedented impact onto the current business scale, organizational structure and business process in corporations. Therefore, great challenges and opportunities both emerged. With the telecom competitive landscape changing and the communications technology developing, China's telecom market has shifted from the seller's to the buyer's. Moreover, the arrival of 3G is injecting vitality to China's information services. Series of industrial policies have triggered structure optimization and reorganization, but also made the Chinese telecom companies face the changing situation more various than ever. How to “victory in changing” becomes an urgent problem of decision-makers to explore and solve. In this paper, we introduce the complex adaptive system, review the development of organizational adaptability, analyze the complex adaptability of telecom operators, and discuss the factors which impact the telecom organization adaptability. According to the analysis, the main factors are organizational mood, communication, staff role, leadership, knowledge. Also we use the empirical research method to statistically analyze 215 questionnaires from different telecom companies and confirm the hypothesis according to the previous analysis. Finally, this paper gives the strategies to improve the adaptability of telecom operators in order to maintain continuing power for development.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamic Model of Re-balancing Ecosystems and Improving Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper establishes a Volterra predator-prey model with three biological populations, and specify the steady-state numbers of the three populations. Then, based on AHP, obtain the ratio of different species in the second population. When other species are not totally suppressed, with an improved predator-prey model we simulate the current situation to obtain predicted numbers of populations, and establish a nonlinear dynamic model that reflects an interdependent set of species, introduces mussels and seaweed growing on the sides of the pens to obtain the numbers of populations in steady state and the outputs of model. Finally, build a nonlinear equilibrium optimization model, from which we obtain an optimal strategy and harvest, and the model is proved can improve the economic development.

articleTitle: An Allocation of Water Resources in Planned Market Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: In this paper, a model of optimal allocation with planned market is presented. At the same time, with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, the solution of this model is obtained. Furthermore, an application of this model applied in JuShui River basin shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Using Manifold Learning and Minimax Probability Machine for Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Face recognition has become one of the most important research areas of pattern recognition and machine learning due to its potential applications in many fields. To effectively cope with this problem, a novel face recognition algorithm is proposed by using manifold learning and minimax probability machine. Comprehensive comparisons and extensive experiments show that the proposed algorithm achieves much higher recognition rates than the ordinary face recognition algorithms.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Method of Product Quality Cooperation Management and Its Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Analysis Hierarchy Process in Factor Analysis of Affecting Concrete Strength
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: It is well known that the concrete strength is affected by a lot of factors, and then traditional qualitative analysis method is main method to analyze concrete strength. It is difficult to quantified analysis. In order to better analyze the factors that affect the concrete strength, Fuzzy Analysis Hierarchy Process is introduced, and the main factor that affects the concrete strength is found out to measure the influence extent. In conclusion, the results of fuzzy evaluation are eventually achieved, which is applied in engineering practice.

articleTitle: The Low Noise Thin-Wall Engine Component Design Based on the Combined FEM-BEM Method and Topology Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The combined FEM-BEM method used to get the frequency response of the vibration and the noise radiation was applied on a gear-box which was the main noise source on the ZH1130 single engine diesel. Based on the prototype using the method, various optimization designs on the component were carried out. And the final design was got through the topology optimization method. The final design was manufactured and the validation experiment was operated, the results show that the SPL of the 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> point in the experiment reduce 1.2 dB.

articleTitle: The Control Research of Explosion Soliton Based on the Parameters for a Nonlinear System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The new exact soliton solutions are constructed by extending the (G'/G)-expansion method for the nonlinear modified generalized Vakhnenko system. The explosion soliton control based on the system parameters is investigated. The explosion soliton shapes can be under the control of the parameters in the soliton solutions.

articleTitle: A Spectral Kernel Learning Algorithm for Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Semi-supervised kernel learning is an important technique for classification and has been actively studied recently. In this paper, we propose a new semi-supervised spectral kernel learning method to learn a new kernel matrix with both labeled data and unlabeled data, which tunes the spectral of a standard kernel matrix by maximizing the margin between two classes. Our approach can be turned into a non-linear optimization problem. We use lagrangian support vector machines and gradient descent algorithm together to solve our optimization problem efficiently. Experimental results show that our spectral kernel learning method is more effective for classification than traditional approaches.

articleTitle: An Experimental Investigation of the Aeroacoustic of Propeller at Low Speeds
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: The aeroacoustic characteristics of propeller-wing were simulated numerically. And the efficiency affected by the installation of angle of the propeller blade was also analyzed. Based on the pressure cloud and streamlines, This experiment used FW-H equation proposed by Ffowcs Williams and Hawkings to imitate the sound generation and dissemination.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Competence of Colleges and Universities Based on Uncertainty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This paper places the competence of Colleges and Universities (CAU) on the foundation of the uncertain characteristic analysis in scale and level of running a school, and describes the attainability of the education indexes for formation of the competence and the controllability of management behaviors. This paper also puts forward the inversion orientation theory for the uncertainty analysis of education behaviors with which the competence of CAU is evaluated. The research shows that it is pivotal to attach importance to the uncertainty analysis in the process of competitions among CAU for improving the competence in future. Meanwhile, risk control in competitions is also the important factor to be considered.

articleTitle: Modeling and Editing Isotropic BRDF
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Reflectance properties of real-world opaque materials can be represented by bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF). Non-parametric BRDF becomes the main aspect nowadays because of its verisimilitude and generality. This paper introduces our BRDF capture equipment and a new compact non-parametric model based on curves for isotropic BRDF. 3D isotropic BRDF data are captured and assembled into a 2D matrix, then decomposed to several 1D curves through twice matrix decomposition, each curve has its own feature, such as specular shape curve, diffuse color curve, etc. The data are compressed effectively, and then reconstructed by these 1D curves during real-time rendering. More important, artist can edit the captured reflectance by adjusting one or more meaningful 1D curve intuitively. Experimental results show that, our method can capture the reflectance data, model and edit BRDF effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Wavelet Adaptive Algorithm in Smart Antenna System for 3G
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: This article is based on the analysis of traditional LMS algorithm, replacing the previous moment gradient with the current one is to be modified LMS (MLMS) algorithm. In order to improve its convergence rate, we proposed the algorithm based on wavelet transform. Processed by the wavelet transform, the correlation of the signal will decline, the convergence speed will improve, and also to the signal de-noising. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good stability, fast convergence rate. Under the big step factor it can also be diminished, and also meets the real-time requirements. At the same time, we do the simulation of the algorithm applied in the smart antenna system, the results show that the system has a smaller and stable bit error rate.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Three Sub-swarms Exchange Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Different Evolvement Model

articleTitle: Industry Structure and Economic Growth: Evidence from Henan Province in China
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: Based on the statistical data released by Henan Statistical Bureau in China, over the period 2000-2008, this paper empirically investigates the relationship between economic growth and industry structure including primary industry, secondary industry, and tertiary industry using the compensative GM (1, N) model in the grey theory. This paper applies the Principle of Least Square Method to estimate the parameters of the system equation. Research results show that the compensative GM (1, N) model established in this paper has a high precision, and could provide valuable information to policy makers in their efforts to make effective economic policies for promoting economic growth.

articleTitle: A Class of Fractal Soliton Structure for a Nonlinear Broer-Kaup System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: By selecting proper functions involved in the known non-traveling wave solution with variable separation, a class of fractal soliton structure is investigated for a nonlinear Broer-Kaup system. The fractal soliton structure can hold its similarity in different scales.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment of the Groundwater Source on Yinchuan Plain
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Modeling, Simulation and Visualization Methods
abstract: According to the characteristic of the groundwater source on the Yinchuan plain and disadvantages of the DRASTIC model in vulnerability assessment for the confined aquifer, 15 impact factors is chosen, each factor is divided into different classification of whose evaluating value is confirmed, then the M-DRASTRIC model is established. This method is used to the confined aquifer for intrinsic vulnerable assessment on the Yinchuan plain. The evaluating results is reasonable compared to the practical condition. It provides a kind of method or thought in the evaluation of intrinsic vulnerability of the confined aquifer on analogous plains of China.
